Permission to read photos and videos is required

This app needs to read photos and videos on your device:

• Photos permission: scan the device gallery and identify the Live Photos in it
• Videos permission: find the companion videos that come with two-file Live Photos
• Location permission: preserve the GPS location metadata in photos (without it, converted photos lose their location information)

If you deny it, the built-in picker cannot be used; you can tap “Add files” later to grant permission again.
Photos and videos permissions must be granted manually

You previously chose “Don't ask again”, so the system no longer shows the permission dialog.

Please go to the app details page → Permissions → Photos and videos, grant access manually, then return to this app.

Note: both the “Photos” and “Videos” permissions must be granted, otherwise two-file Live Photos will not be able to find their companion videos.
Automatically deleting originals requires “All files access”
This device does not support automatically deleting originals
Replace mode requires “All files access”
This device does not support replace mode
Granting “All files access” is recommended

“Delete originals after processing” deletes the original files on disk directly (the photo and its companion video). This cannot be undone, so “All files access” must be granted first.\n\nThe switch becomes available once you grant it; you can turn it on yourself then.

The current system (Android 10 or lower) does not provide “All files access”, so original files on disk cannot be deleted directly; this device therefore does not support “Delete originals after processing”.\n\nYou can clean up the originals manually in the system gallery after conversion.

“Replace mode” writes the conversion result straight back to the original files on disk (overwriting their contents). This cannot be undone, so “All files access” must be granted first.\n\nThe switch becomes available once you grant it; you can turn it on yourself then.

The current system (Android 10 or lower) does not provide “All files access”, so original files on disk cannot be rewritten directly; this device therefore does not support “Replace mode”.\n\nYou can keep converting in the default way; the results are written into the gallery folder.

On some devices (such as Meizu), writing through the system gallery API strips GPS location information, so converted photos lose their location.

Once you grant “All files access”, this app writes directly into the gallery folder and fully preserves the location metadata.

Conversion still works without it, but some devices may lose location information.
